title: North and South

vibeProfile.oneLine: A southern girl clashes with a northern mill owner, and industrial England.

summary: Uprooted from the gentle south of England to a harsh northern mill town, Margaret Hale collides with the industrial world, its strikes and its poverty, and with the proud manufacturer John Thornton. Gaskell weaves a slow-burning romance into a serious study of the divide between agrarian south and industrial north, masters and workers, prejudice and understanding. Both a love story and a thoughtful social novel, it gives its heroine real moral and political weight.
whyReadIt: A slow-burn romance wrapped in a serious novel about industrial England. Its heroine has real spine.

funFacts.text: Gaskell wrote it partly to give the industrial working class a sympathetic voice in fiction.
